title: Save a proposed design version
responsibility: Generates visual design options or keeps behavior notes, then saves one version for review.

inputs.name: planDesign.context
inputs.description: The prepared Plan context, including entity, selected thread, project revision, request, image model and generator, planning connection, cancellation signal and progress callback.

inputs.name: planDesign.prompt
inputs.description: The proposal text. Visual categories use it to build image instructions; functions, configs and services retain it as notes without generating images.

outputs.name: planDesign
outputs.description: For pages/layouts/components, generates 1–10 options (three by default) sequentially and saves a design version. Prefers an anchored thread image, otherwise the latest wanted design image matching state/viewport when possible; reads exact version/hash/revision/option bytes through planning.image. If no wanted image exists, uses optional trusted currentImage bytes. Writes the reference to an owned temporary file and passes it to every generator call; when unavailable emits an explicit status and uses no reference. Saved options themselves have no preferred flag; feature plans carry preference. Returns Saved <version> for review.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects when cancellation is observed after a generation or before saving. Generated options are not saved if generation fails or is cancelled before the save step.

errors.name: reference, generator or persistence failure
errors.description: Reference/image generation failures occur before design save. Invalid design option counts and cancellation clean owned temporary paths. Message persistence can fail after a design is saved; no rollback.
